title: Aggrega Workload
description: Platform-owned abstract workload specification. A Recipe using synthesized mode declares exactly one Workload via the workload: keyword (inline block scalar or workload: { $import: <path> } per the unified file-import vocabulary). The target provider Engine translates the Workload into provider-native manifests (K8s Deployment/StatefulSet/Services/PVCs for helm; compose services + volumes + networks for compose; etc.). The Workload kind is NOT a catalog entity — it lives in the aggrega-cli binary (embedded JSON Schema at pkg/schemas/jsonschema/workload.json) alongside the canonical JSON schema published here.

labels.description: Author-declared labels. Merged with aggrega.ai/* provenance labels at emission (author values preserved; aggrega keys overwrite on collision).

annotations.description: Author-declared annotations on the workload. Translated to pod template annotations for helm, compose labels for compose.

form.description: Abstract controller-shape intent for the workload. Chooses the kind of runtime lifecycle the workload has, independent of any target platform: stateless (interchangeable long-running replicas), stateful (replicas with stable per-replica identity and per-replica storage), daemon (one instance per eligible host), scheduled (recurring, time-triggered runs), task (a single run to completion). Empty is treated as stateless. Each target Engine maps the form to its own native shape; the form carries no platform-native resource kinds itself. A persistentTemplate volume is a companion of stateful and is only valid on a stateful workload.

schedule.description: Cron schedule for form: scheduled — a standard 5-field crontab expression (for example '0 0 * * *') or one of the macros @hourly, @daily, @weekly, @monthly, @yearly. Required when form is scheduled and only meaningful then; the target Engine pipes it verbatim into the scheduled resource's schedule field.

replicas.description: Number of replicas. Default 1. Compose ignores values > 1 unless the target compose spec supports scaling.

initContainers.description: Ordered list of containers that run to completion before the main containers start.

containers.description: Ordered map of container name → container spec. At least one entry required. YAML author order is preserved by the Go parser.

volumes.description: Ordered map of volume name → volume spec. Each volume spec declares exactly one of: ephemeral, configmap, secret, persistent, persistentTemplate.

services.description: Ordered map of service name → service spec. Each becomes a separate K8s Service (helm) or port-publishing rule on the compose service (compose). Service names are suffixed by aggrega instance_id for K8s resource-name uniqueness.

scheduling.description: K8s-native scheduling constraints. Translated directly for helm; ignored (with warning) for compose except where compose has analogs.

serviceAccount.description: Name of the ServiceAccount this workload runs under. Actual RBAC (ServiceAccount/Role/RoleBinding resources) should be emitted via Features or artifacts, not via this field.

name.description: Optional container name. For a positional initContainers entry it sets the emitted container name, falling back to a generated init-<index> name (the entry's position in the list) when omitted. For a containers map entry the map key is the container name and this field is ignored.

command.description: Override the image's entrypoint. K8s: .command. Compose: entrypoint.

args.description: Arguments passed to command (or image entrypoint if command is absent). K8s: .args. Compose: command.

variables.description: Environment variables as string key-value pairs. K8s: spec.template.spec.containers[].env[]. Compose: services.<name>.environment.

secrets.description: Ordered map of env-or-file name → { from, as, path? }. Each entry references a slot declared in the Component's secretsSchema. The 'as' field selects the delivery mechanism, which must be allowlisted in the slot's inject: array. Blackbox slots (inject: []) MAY NOT appear here.

ports.description: Named container ports. Port names referenced by services.*.ports and by probe http intent (port resolution). K8s: containerPort. Compose: expose/ports.

health.description: Probe intents (http/tcp/exec). Translated to K8s httpGet/tcpSocket/exec for helm; CMD-SHELL healthchecks for compose (degraded — warning emitted).

name.description: Must match a key in top-level volumes: map.

from.description: Name of a slot declared in the Component's secretsSchema.

as.description: Delivery mechanism. Must be allowlisted in the slot's inject: array.

key.description: For as: env, the specific data key of the referenced slot's secret this entry reads. Set it when the slot's secret carries several data keys, so this entry selects one of them by name; two entries may reference the same slot with different keys to read several keys from one secret. When omitted, the entry reads the slot's single published key. Ignored for as: file, which mounts the whole secret.

path.description: File path inside the container (required when as: file).

cpu.description: K8s quantity (e.g., '100m', '0.5', '2'). Compose translates to cpus fractional.

memory.description: K8s quantity (e.g., '128Mi', '1Gi'). Compose translates to mem_limit bytes.

http.description: HTTP GET probe. Path is probed against the first container port (alphabetical by name) unless explicit port is supplied via namespaced form (deferred — single-string form is the current contract).

tcp.description: TCP socket probe on the given container port number.

exec.description: Exec probe — the command to run inside the container.

httpGet.description: K8s-native httpGet shape (path, port, scheme, host, httpHeaders). Passed through to helm; compose translates to HEALTHCHECK-equivalent where possible.

sizeLimit.description: K8s quantity (e.g., '1Gi'). K8s: emptyDir.sizeLimit. Compose: tmpfs (size approximation; warning emitted).

source.description: Name of the ConfigMap (must be emitted by this Recipe via artifacts:, or by an attached Feature — cross-Recipe refs are forbidden per self-containment §4.4).

persistentTemplate.description: Per-replica claim template. Requires form: stateful, because only the stateful shape gives each replica the stable identity a per-replica claim needs. On Kubernetes it becomes StatefulSet.volumeClaimTemplates; compose degrades to a single named volume with a warning comment.

type.description: Service type. Headless → K8s Service with clusterIP: None; compose treats ClusterIP as internal-only and LoadBalancer/NodePort as port-publishing.

ports.description: Map of service port name → container port number. Port names must match keys in containers.<any>.ports.
